interpretation.claim_text: Discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed.
interpretation.rationale: The focal passage establishes that discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed. This is stated by Diane Okafor, who mentions that "Anything over 15% goes to Harriet. That's been the rule since we bumped the threshold last year." The context passage clarifies that Harriet is the person responsible for approving discounts above 15%, and that this rule has been in place since the threshold was bumped last year.
